title: Page 6
lines: 第一章 偏心的娘亲(1)
“死丫头，都日上三竿了还敢赖在屋子里，看我不打死你！”
迷迷糊糊之中，赵小丫被从床上拽了下来，好些时候回不过神，腰间被用力的拧，耳边响起的咒骂令她个激灵，怀疑的捂着自己的双耳。
她听得见？她再次听得见了？
她失聪多年，早已习惯了安静的世界，没想到现在……
她忍不住想笑，眼角余光看到个阴影靠近，下意识的伸出手把捉住要挥向她的扫把。
直以来，赵小丫便是个打不还手骂不还口的懦弱性子，猛反抗倒令刘彩凤愣住。
赵小丫黑黝黝的眼珠子像是看陌生人似的盯着她，刘彩凤回过神，松开了扫把，手不留情的甩了过去，“胆肥了，还敢瞪着我瞧。”
赵小丫翻身想躲，但浑身痛得没有力气，原该落在她脸上的巴掌最终狠狠地打在她的背上，她痛得哼了声。
刘彩凤气呼呼的叉腰看着她，“我告诉你，你最好死心，今天你就算死了也得给我嫁到李家村去。”
赵小丫的脑子糊涂了，只觉得眼前切熟悉又陌生得可怕，顾不得身上的痛楚，跌跌撞撞的冲了出去，就连撞到了人，脚步也不停。
“死丫头！”刘彩凤伸手要捉但扑了个空，追了几步朝着她的背影吼道：“你有胆子就死在外头不要回来！”
被撞了个踉跄的赵雪捂着肩，秀气的眉头轻皱，“娘，你这是怎么了？大清早吵吵闹闹，不让人安生。”
刘彩凤看到自己的大闺女，脸色微敛，“还不是那个死丫头，睡到这个时候，你瞧瞧，炉灶还是冷的。”
赵雪看着灶房的冷锅冷灶，心底也是不满，只不过她不像刘彩凤总将厌恶表现在脸上，“算了，兴许是还在闹脾气，过几日就好了。时候不早了，我去弄点吃的。”
刘彩凤又咒骂了赵小丫几句，拉住了赵雪，“我的好闺女，你别沾手，先回房去坐着。今日还得进城里去跟程娘子学字，别弄脏了衣裳。”
“还是娘对我好。”赵雪不忘夸刘彩凤句。
“我就这么个大闺女，自然对你好。”刘彩凤走进了灶房，忙着起火煮食。
赵雪原想回屋子，但看着被赵小丫
“那个死丫头能去哪里？”关于这点刘彩凤根本不担心，“离了这个家，她身无分文，只能死在外头。”
赵雪与赵小丫不过相差岁，但是赵雪已经长得亭亭玉立，头秀发乌黑亮丽，每隔五日还会被刘彩凤送进城去跟女夫子学琴棋书画，但赵小丫却是瘦骨嶙峋，顶着头枯黄的头发在家里做牛做马。
“娘，这次难道是我们做得太过了吗？”
刘彩凤哼了声，将火升起，拿着挂在腰间的钥匙
“她明年十五，现在定下亲事怎么不成？”刘彩凤说得脸不红气不喘，压根没想到赵雪今年十五，若要订亲也该是她先，“这次李家给了五十两银子当彩礼。”
赵雪闻言眼睛亮，“这么多？”
刘彩凤点了点头，压低声音对赵雪说：“这些钱让你明年进京用，凭我好闺女的容貌，怎么可以埋没在这个破烂山村呢。”
赵雪的脸微红，她长得确实极好，是这十里八村的大美人，对她有心思的人家不少，但是刘彩凤的眼界高，全都看不上眼。
刘彩凤年轻时是光州城内的姑娘，要不是有个没出息的兄长，败光了家产，她再怎么样也不可能嫁到城外的大山村来。
赵雪心如明镜，知道低嫁这事是她娘心中的根刺，所以打小便特别疼她，散尽家产也要让她学习大户人家闺女的作派。
赵小丫却是同娘不同命，与其说是赵家的闺女，不如说是赵家的奴才。天与地的待遇，村里人见了也不是没议论，最后只能说赵小丫跟自己的亲娘没缘分，谁叫赵小丫长得不像她娘，瞧瞧赵雪就像极了刘彩凤年轻时的样子，长得漂亮自然讨人喜欢。
刘彩凤前些日子替赵小丫寻了门亲事，这门亲事说穿了就是卖了赵小丫，让赵雪有盘缠可以进京嫁高门。
谁知道向来听话的赵小丫竟然在亲事上与刘彩凤杠上了。
赵雪想到五十两银子，心思动了起来，“娘，若是小丫死也不嫁怎么办？”
刘彩凤的眼底闪过丝阴狠，“她不嫁，我绑也绑着她嫁。”
她阵恼火，原以为打赵小丫顿这丫头就会安分，谁知道今天起来倒好，竟然甩头出了门，这可不成。
她摇了摇头，“看来我得想个办法。”
自小娇养的女儿长得如她年轻时貌美，今年十五，再不快点给她挑门亲事就太迟了。只是要进京去，身上没备足银钱也不成，所以她才动了把赵小丫的亲事定下换彩礼的念头。
刘彩凤从没打算带着赵小丫同进京，想到她的长相就觉得倒胃口，等她明年十五，就把她嫁到比这里更遍远的李家村给李虎当媳妇。
李虎是个傻子，不然也不会拿出这么多的彩礼娶媳妇。
这事儿李家没瞒，刘彩凤也不在意，反正在她眼中赵小丫命贱，能嫁给傻子也是福气。
“娘能想到什么法子？”赵雪低垂着头，装出副不安的神情，“小丫这次咬死不嫁，若闹开来，只怕你想将小丫嫁人，村子里的人也不同意。”
刘彩凤阵心烦，皱起了眉。
大山村因靠近光州，所以村民日子过得还不错，但就是平时爱管闲事，她管教赵小丫的时候没少见人来拦，成亲这种大事若是赵小丫真闹起来，这还真说不准……
死丫头笨了辈子，没想到还知道女人嫁人若是嫁不好，这辈子就完了。
“娘，我前些日子在师傅那里听说城里有个姑娘被人发现跟个男人在床上，闹了个没脸，急急地被爹娘给嫁了出去，你说这事儿……”赵雪的话音隐去，没将话说完。
刘彩凤下子就意会，立刻笑开来，“还是咱们赵雪聪明，娘知道怎么做了。”
赵雪脸上带着浅笑，“我也是看娘烦恼才说上嘴。”
“知道了！知道你乖。”刘彩凤将煎得香喷喷的蛋给她，“拿去堂屋吃吧。”
“谢谢娘。”赵雪笑了笑，个转头就看到进门的赵老爹。
赵老爹起床，东西都没吃就去田里浇水。
赵雪对刘彩凤使了个眼神，刘彩凤点了点头表示知道。这个老头子心软，若真让他知道点什么，就怕会来破坏。
“死老头！”刘彩凤扯着嗓子嚷道：“那个死丫头饭也不做就跑出去，你还不过来煮东西，难不成还要老娘伺候你不成？”
赵老爹低头闻着屋中的香味，看到赵雪坐在堂屋里吃的东西，心中叹，却没有怨言，只是久久才挤出句，“小丫不嫁，你就别逼她。”
“闭上你的嘴。”刘彩凤从柜子里拿出点米粮让赵老爹熬粥，然后又将柜子锁上，“要不是因为你没出息，我有必要这么辛苦地谋算吗？”
赵老爹边在锅中加水，边叹了口气，他这辈子被欺压惯了，早放弃反击。
他都快忘了当年第次在城里看到刘彩凤时那莫名的喜悦感受，想当年他虽父母早亡，但父母留下了些家产，再加上自己的木工手艺，因此也存了些银钱。这漂亮的姑娘下子令他看直了眼，要不是刘彩凤因哥哥闹了事，家中正缺银两，他砸锅卖铁的凑足了彩金，只怕这辈子也没福气娶到貌美的刘彩凤。

Chapter 1 The Partial Mother (1)
"Damn girl, you dare to stay in the house even though the sun has gone up three times, let's see if I don't beat you to death!"
In a daze, Zhao Xiaoya was pulled off the bed. She couldn't regain consciousness for a while. Her waist was squeezed hard, and the curses that rang in her ears made her jump. She covered her ears in suspicion.
Can she hear it? Can she hear again?
She has been deaf for many years and has long been accustomed to a quiet world. Unexpectedly, now...
She couldn't help but want to laugh, but she saw a shadow approaching from the corner of her eye, and subconsciously reached out to grab the broom that was about to be swung at her.
Zhao Xiaoya had always been a coward who would not fight back or retaliate, but Liu Caifeng was stunned when she resisted so fiercely.
Zhao Xiaoya's dark eyes stared at her as if she were a stranger. Liu Caifeng came back to her senses, let go of the broom, and threw it away mercilessly, "How dare you stare at me?"
Zhao Xiaoya turned over and tried to hide, but her whole body was so painful that she had no strength. The slap that was supposed to fall on her face ended up hitting her hard on the back, and she groaned in pain.
Liu Caifeng looked at her with her hands on her hips angrily, "I tell you, you'd better give up. Even if you die today, you have to marry me to Lijia Village."
Zhao Xiaoya's mind was confused and she felt that everything in front of her was familiar yet terrifyingly unfamiliar. She ignored the pain on her body and stumbled out, not stopping even when she bumped into someone.
"Damn girl!" Liu Caifeng stretched out her hand to catch her but missed her. He chased her a few steps and shouted at her back: "If you have the guts, die outside and don't come back!"
Zhao Xue, who was staggered by the collision, covered her shoulders and frowned slightly, "Mom, what's wrong with you? It's so noisy early in the morning that it doesn't let people live in peace."
When Liu Caifeng saw her eldest daughter, her face turned slightly, "She's not that dead girl. She's sleeping until this time. Look, the stove is still cold."
Zhao Xue looked at the cold pot and stove in the kitchen, feeling dissatisfied in her heart, but unlike Liu Caifeng, who always showed disgust on her face, "Forget it, maybe I'm still having a temper, and I'll be fine in a few days. It's getting late, I'll go get something to eat."
Liu Caifeng cursed Zhao Xiaoya a few more times and pulled Zhao Xue, "My good girl, don't touch her. Go back to your room and sit down first. You have to go into the city today to learn calligraphy from Mrs. Cheng, so don't get your clothes dirty."
"Mom is still good to me." Zhao Xue did not forget to praise Liu Caifeng.
"I'm such a big girl, so I'll naturally treat you well." Liu Caifeng walked into the kitchen and was busy cooking.
Zhao Xueyuan wanted to go back to the house, but saw that Zhao Xiaoya was
"Where can that dead girl go?" Liu Caifeng is not worried about this at all. "She will be penniless after leaving this home and can only die outside."
There is only a year difference between Zhao Xue and Zhao Xiaoya, but Zhao Xue is already tall and slim, with beautiful black hair. Every five days, Liu Caifeng will send her to the city to learn piano, chess, calligraphy and painting from her wife, but Zhao Xiaoya is skinny, with yellow hair and works as a cow and horse at home.
"Mom, did we go too far this time?"
Liu Caifeng snorted, raised the fire, and held the key hanging on her waist.
"She is fifteen next year, why can't we get married now?" Liu Caifeng said without blushing or out of breath. She never thought that Zhao Xue would be fifteen this year, so she should be the first to get engaged. "This time, the Li family gave fifty taels of silver as a bride price."
Zhao Xue's eyes lit up when she heard this, "So many?"
Liu Caifeng nodded, lowered her voice and said to Zhao Xue: "This money is for you to go to Beijing next year. How can my good daughter be buried in this shabby mountain village with her appearance?"
Zhao Xue's face was slightly red. She was indeed very good-looking. She was the most beautiful woman in eight villages. There were many people who were interested in her, but Liu Caifeng had a high vision and they all looked down upon her.
When Liu Caifeng was young, she was a girl from Guangzhou City. If she hadn't had a useless brother who lost all her family property, she would never have been able to marry into a mountain village outside the city.
Zhao Xue's heart was as bright as a mirror, and she knew that marrying lowly was a thorn in her mother's heart, so it hurt her very much to urinate, and even if she had to spend all her property, she would learn to behave like a daughter from a wealthy family.
Zhao Xiaoya, on the other hand, has the same mother but different destiny. She is more like a slave of the Zhao family than a daughter of the Zhao family. The treatment of Heaven and Earth was not without discussion among the villagers. In the end, they could only say that Zhao Xiaoya had no fate with her own mother. Why did Zhao Xiaoya not look like her mother? Zhao Xue looked exactly like Liu Caifeng when she was young. She was beautiful and naturally lovable.
Liu Caifeng found a match for Zhao Xiaoya a few days ago. To be honest, this match was to sell Zhao Xiaoya so that Zhao Xue could go to Beijing and marry a high-ranking family if she had the money.
Who knew that Zhao Xiaoya, who had always been obedient, would actually get into trouble with Liu Caifeng over their marriage.
Zhao Xue thought about fifty taels of silver, and her thoughts arose, "Mom, what if Xiaoya dies without getting married?"
Liu Caifeng's eyes flashed with sinisterness, "If she doesn't want to marry, I will tie her up to marry her."
She was annoyed. She thought that beating Zhao Xiaoya would calm the girl down. Who knew that it would be a good day to wake up, but she actually shook her head and walked out of the door. This was not possible.
She shook her head, "It seems I have to find a way."
The daughter who has been pampered since childhood is as beautiful as she was when she was young. She is fifteen this year, and it will be too late if she doesn't find a match for her soon. It was just a matter of going to Beijing without enough money, so she had the idea of ​​​​arranging Zhao Xiaoya's marriage in exchange for a betrothal gift.
Liu Caifeng never planned to take Zhao Xiaoya to Beijing with her. The thought of her appearance made her feel off-putting. When she is fifteen next year, she will marry her to Lijia Village, which is further away than here, to be Li Hu's wife.
Li Hu is a fool, otherwise he would not have given so many gifts to marry a wife.
The Li family didn't hide this matter, and Liu Caifeng didn't care. Anyway, in her eyes, Zhao Xiaoya had a low life, and being able to marry a fool was a blessing.
"What ideas can mother think of?" Zhao Xue lowered her head, pretending to be uneasy, "Xiaoya will not marry this time. If there is a quarrel, I am afraid that if you want to marry Xiaoya, the people in the village will not agree."
Liu Caifeng was upset and frowned.
Dashan Village is close to Guangzhou, so the life of the villagers is pretty good, but they are usually nosy, and people often come to stop her when she disciplines Zhao Xiaoya. If Zhao Xiaoya really makes a big deal like getting married, it's really uncertain...
This girl has been stupid all her life, but she didn't expect to know that if a woman doesn't marry well, her life will be over.
"Mom, I heard from my master a few days ago that there was a girl in the city who was found in bed with a man. She was so embarrassed that she was married off by her parents in a hurry. You said this..." Zhao Xue's words faded away and she did not finish her words.
Liu Caifeng understood immediately and smiled immediately, "We, Zhao Xue, are still smart. Mom knows what to do."
Zhao Xue had a slight smile on her face, "I only talked about it because I saw my mother was troubled."
"I know! I know you're good." Liu Caifeng gave her the deliciously fried eggs, "Take them to the main room to eat."
"Thank you, mother." Zhao Xue smiled, turned around and saw Father Zhao entering the door.
Father Zhao got up and went to water the fields without eating anything.
Zhao Xue glanced at Liu Caifeng, and Liu Caifeng nodded to express her understanding. This old man is soft-hearted, and if he really knows something, he is afraid that he will come to destroy it.
"Damn old man!" Liu Caifeng shouted at the top of her lungs: "That damn girl ran out without cooking. If you don't come over to cook, do you think you still have to wait on me?"
Father Zhao lowered his head and smelled the fragrance in the room. When he saw Zhao Xue sitting in the main room eating, he sighed in his heart, but he didn't complain. He just took a long time to say, "If Xiaoya doesn't want to marry, don't force her."
"Shut your mouth." Liu Caifeng took out some rice from the cabinet for Father Zhao to make porridge, and then locked the cabinet. "If it weren't for your lack of future, would it be necessary for me to plan so hard?"
Father Zhao sighed as he added water to the pot. He was used to being bullied in his life and had long given up on fighting back.
He had almost forgotten the inexplicable joy he felt when he saw Liu Caifeng in the city for the first time. He thought that although his parents died early, they left some property and coupled with his carpentry skills, he also saved some money. This beautiful girl suddenly made him look straight in his eyes. If Liu Caifeng hadn't caused trouble with her brother and the family was short of silver, and he sold iron to collect the winnings, he might not have been lucky enough to marry the beautiful Liu Caifeng in this life.
